name: Tlemcen

queries.query: Algeria official cadastral map parcel viewer API Tlemcen cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified InfoGéolAlgérie, the official ASGA national cartography viewer at 1:200,000, and the official DGDN domain. The indexed viewer description exposes national map layers such as wilaya and communes, but does not evidence a public parcel layer or parcel API for Tlemcen.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and French/Arabic discovery, followed by bounded TLS-verified GET attempts; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or global TLS disablement.
